# Task data and contract compatibility matrix

2026-10-17, read-only consolidated audit. See [findings and verdict](task-read-architecture-audit.md) and [implementation handoff](../services/TASK-SERVICE-NATIVE-WRITING-HANDOFF.md).

**N** backend-neutral; **L** legacy-only by design; **T** transitional compatibility; **S** native-specific; **?** unresolved contract or migration decision. Adequate representation does not imply a migration/import command or production adapter exists.

| Field / behavior | Legacy authoritative evidence | Facade DTO / read contract | Existing action/write bridge | Phase 2A native record | Classification / required decision |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Parent identity | Optional hidden hub-task comment, alphanumeric/hyphens | Legacy hidden-ID or null plus locator; native handle variant exists | ID-less read does not allocate; enrollment/metadata/move may assign; retry accepts caller ID | Required canonical lowercase UUID, globally reserved including deletion | N/S identity concept, L locator, ? alias ledger for valid non-UUID legacy IDs. Never silently replace persisted Oath IDs. |
| ID-less parent | Path + line + normalized first title; not durable | Explicit null identity, no synthetic persistent ID | Guarded action; ambiguous identical titles generally blocked; Oath parent enrollment has its existing distinct policy | Cannot persist ID-less native task | T. Allocate migration identity once in a reviewed receipt/ledger, not during ordinary reads. |
| Duplicate/copy identity | Global parent + Step namespace; copies can be indexed/displayed | Diagnostic ambiguous rows, display without action | Source/uniqueness preflight; Oath parent eligibility intentionally differs for copied Step IDs | Invalid across tasks/Steps/retired IDs | N uniqueness, ? quarantine/review before import. Do not deduplicate by title or choose a winner. |
| Render/selection identity | Temporary line/title keys; Oath taskKey | Handles plus consumer keys; historyReadKey adds occurrence | Never persist UI keys as task identity | Persistent UUID task/Step identities separate | N distinction. Preserve duplicate recorded rows even if keys differ. |
| Title | First task line, Hub comment stripped; Tasks syntax remains content | Canonical title separate from indexed display/search text | Snapshot exact-block and normalized-title checks | Nonempty single-line title | N title; T full-text compatibility. Title change must not orphan stable commitment. |
| Full indexed/source text | Dataview continuations, Markdown prose/lists, original block/EOL | Display compatibility text; structured legacy ref; editable token keeps source block privately | Source writer preserves unrelated content and Step structure | No dedicated full Markdown block field | ? Lossless migration/provenance policy. Native description must not silently absorb note continuations. Keep original evidence outside active native title if necessary. |
| Description | Explicit identity-keyed metadata Markdown string | description distinct from title/continuation | validate/save effective metadata | description string | N; map only explicit description. |
| Step identity | Optional hub-task ID; ordinal/line used within parent snapshot | Legacy-step(parent identity, optional ID, ordinal) vs native-step ID | Step must match same editable snapshot/parent | Required UUID, taskId, globally reserved | N/S. Allocate missing IDs in migration ledger; keep parent+Step aliases and lineage. |
| Nested Steps | Markdown indentation/block ancestry through non-task lists | Output TaskStep has parent handle + sibling order | Legacy save retains existing snapshot structure; inline add supports current restrictions | parentStepId + order, cycle/parent/order validation | N output; ? editable StepDraft lacks parent/order fields. Specify native create/edit ancestry; do not flatten. |
| Step metadata | Source text/state and completion checks; not separate primary task owner | Title/completion/parent/order; dates/Necessity belong to parent task projection | Source range controls deletion and nested edits | Step title/state/timestamps, no independent owner/Phase/date/description | Compatible with current parent/Step model; inventory any unsupported user syntax as evidence, not new metadata authority. |

Preserve Home presentation separately during read migration; never change owner to fit a Home section. |

On migration **source note's parent folder becomes folder context**; provenance note is not automatic permanent note association. |

Preserve unknown historical times as null. |

Never count all retained native events blindly. |

No silent normalization. |

Preserve explicit midnight. |

Resource tasks cannot carry Project Phase. |

## Evidence anchors

- `lib/services/task-service-contract.d.ts:25,31,56,65,84,118,136,174`: draft, display/structured/Oath/recorded and mutation shapes.
- `lib/services/task-service-legacy-values.js:28,47,67,100`: legacy IDs, handles, native-shaped projection and edit draft.
- `lib/domain/task-planning.js:14,31`, `lib/domain/tasks.js:28,34,42`: explicit metadata, validation, title and source identity.
- `lib/services/task-service-legacy-read.js:10,48,61`: hierarchical Steps and primitive compatibility evidence.
- `lib/services/task-history-legacy-read.js:10`, `lib/domain/statistics.js:54,64`: raw history scalar fidelity and counting order.
- `ItacanTaskCore/src/domain.js:33,65,99`, `commands.js:8,52,58,91`, `contracts.d.ts:20,29,35,101`: native constraints, completion commands and export.
- Fresh disposable `audit-probes.json` reproduces reversed clock, non-UUID ID, native-to-legacy converter rejection, unknown partition rejection, fresh completion event, and independent session scan counts. These are verified compatibility limits, not data changes or active runtime regressions.
